note: Gate-checkable projection of the QA Checklist in ../../SKILL.md (authoritative). type=python checks are computable via genie_user_guide.py; type=manual require agent/terminology-parity inspection.

GATE_1_foundation.text: Trademark Clearance Report done; title framing confirmed nominative fair use; verdict CLEAR or operator-approved CAUTION
All subtitle candidates passed the trademark screen
Covered product version explicitly identified and recorded; if absent from title, operator confirmed it before proceeding
Version declaration drafted for the Copyright Page
Product Architecture Map complete (software: navigation + feature categories; hardware: nomenclature + control interfaces)
Primary user task set identified and mapped to chapter structure
Chapter titles reference user actions, not features by name
Audience, prerequisites, and system requirements documented
Competitor version analysis complete; competing titles' versions noted
Auto-configuration announced (pathway, page band, visual density, font, spacing, screenshot convention, Design Signature) and internally consistent
Trademark acknowledgment language drafted for the Copyright Page
Warning hierarchy format confirmed (ANSI Z535.6 / ISO/IEC 82079-1)

GATE_2_per_chapter_development.text: Chapter title names a user task, not a product feature
Every procedure has a Pre-Step block listing prerequisites and version
Every step contains exactly one action verb and one instruction
Every UI element name in steps is bold and matches the product exactly (terminology parity spot check)
Warning boxes use ANSI hierarchy only (DANGER/WARNING/CAUTION/NOTICE/VERSION NOTE); no non-standard advisory formats
Warnings placed at the step where the risk occurs, not only in front matter
Version Notes present at all steps that differ from the prior major version
Screenshots (or SCREENSHOT DESCRIPTION blocks) present for every procedure step needing visual reference; callout tables present
Anti-AI language protocol enforced; no prohibited phrases
Chapter ends with a Chapter Checkpoint (3-5 bullets)

GATE_3_terminology_parity.text: Technical Communication Authority completed terminology parity check for all UI names in this chapter; zero mismatches
UI/UX Specialist confirmed all menu paths, button sequences, and screen flows accurate for the covered version
All warning placements reviewed for ANSI Z535.6 compliance
Instructional Design Authority confirms procedures are executable as written at the declared skill level
All screenshots/descriptions current to the covered version; no prior-version UI states
Version Notes present and accurate wherever prior-version differences exist
Safety content accuracy 100%; no missing callout, no incorrect hierarchy level
Chapter word count and page estimate within page-band targets

GATE_4_final_certification.text: All chapters organized by user task, not by feature
Covered version named on Title Page, Introduction first paragraph, Copyright Page, and KDP metadata
Copyright Page disclaimer: version, date, no-affiliation statement, trademark acknowledgment, future-version variance
Front matter complete and in order: Title Page, Copyright Page, TOC, Preface, How to Use This Book, Introduction
Preface exactly 1 page; How to Use This Book exactly 1 page; Conclusion exactly 1.5 pages
Getting Started / Setup chapter enables complete first-use success in one session
Troubleshooting appendix covers the top 10 documented user problems
Visible page numbers start at Introduction (page 1); front matter unnumbered
Design Signature applied consistently; logged in register; no repeat
Author name consistent across Title Page, Copyright Page, and all metadata
KDP categories correct; version number present in metadata keywords
Terminology parity confirmed across all chapters; Interface Element Naming Index cross-referenced against all in-text references
No prohibited AI-pattern language in any chapter
Warning hierarchy compliance confirmed across all chapters (ANSI Z535.6 / ISO/IEC 82079-1)
